I added `migrations/003_exports_status_default.sql`. I haven't run it or tested it against a database.

It does three things:
1. Sets any existing NULL `status` values on `exports` to `'queued'`. `SET NOT NULL` would fail if any NULLs were left.
2. Sets the column default to `'queued'`.
3. Makes the column `NOT NULL`.

I left `001_init.sql` alone, since databases that already ran it wouldn't pick up an edit.

The backfill marks every existing NULL row as `queued`, including old jobs that may have actually finished or failed. If you'd rather set those to something else, change the value in the `update` line.

I didn't look at `src/exports/sink.ts`. If it explicitly inserts `NULL` for `status`, that insert will now fail instead of silently storing NULL.
